question.text: Under Section 20 of the Depositories Act, what is the maximum fine for contravention of the Act?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Section 20 of the Depositories Act, a person who contravenes the Act may be punished with imprisonment up to 10 years, or with fine up to Rs 25 crores, or with both. This is without prejudice to any penalty imposed by an adjudicating officer or SEBI under other provisions of the Act. The Trap: Rs 1 crore and Rs 10 crores belong to other penalty bands, while Rs 50 crores is not a Section 20 cap. The civil penalty under Section 19FA on the same page may extend to Rs 25 crores or three times the gains, whichever is higher, so it is not capped at Rs 25 crores in every scenario. Note: Section 20 (criminal) and Section 19FA (civil) operate without prejudice to each other, so both may apply for the same conduct based on their own thresholds.
